summary: The Acorn Squirrel as a hopping follower (the second flute friend): the trail squirrel critter's design (public/assets/critters/squirrel/, calm_idle_01) drawn as a follower's six animations, a little under Maddie's size.
generationSource: Generated with Gemini: a character in the game's own painted style, which no open source has (docs/media-sources.md is for sounds and photos).
references: art/source/pond-pup/model-sheet.png: the follower style and size, for the model sheet
art/source/pond-pup/back-grid.png: the grid layout, for call 8

referenceNotes.scratch:: Temporary crops in the session's scratch folder, made from images listed here and keyed on green with a 60 px border unless noted.
referenceNotes.scratch:squirrel-calm-ref.png: calm_idle_01 from the squirrel critter atlas, on white.
referenceNotes.scratch:side-left-ref.png: The model sheet's figure 3 (his left side).
referenceNotes.scratch:front-allfours-ref.png: The model sheet's figure 4 (standing, facing us).
referenceNotes.art/source/acorn-squirrel/back-strip.png: At calls 23 and 24 already the kept back strip (call 21).
referenceNotes.art/source/acorn-squirrel/front-strip.pn: At call 25, call 24's output (since replaced by call 25's).

callNotes: 25 calls, none failed. The hop toward the camera took 13 of them: each strip failed a validator check (a three-quarter turn, the head changing size, the silhouette area changing more than 1.20x) or couldn't be cut apart, until call 25. The kept sources are the model's own outputs, byte for byte.

sources.art/source/acorn-squirrel/model-sheet.pn: His model sheet: sitting up facing us, his back, his left side on all fours, and standing facing us. The idles are the first three (idle_down, idle_up, idle_left); the fourth is unused.
sources.art/source/acorn-squirrel/front-strip.pn: walk_down: six upright hops toward us in a row, a small bob, the tail a plume behind his head.
sources.art/source/acorn-squirrel/back-strip.png: walk_up: six upright hops away in a row, from directly behind.
sources.art/source/acorn-squirrel/left-grid.png: walk_left: one bound on all fours, a 3x2 grid read row by row.

postProcessing: tools/art/build-acorn-squirrel.ts rebuilds the atlas byte for byte from the four sources.
tools/art/extract-figures.ts cuts each sheet into whole figures, read row by row; a figure is never cropped.
Key #00FF00 (he is red-brown, cream, pink, and acorn brown), key-alpha with holes; despill on the 2 px alpha edge only.

One uniform scale per sheet (postprocess.ts --scale-percent). The model sheet at 10.5% sits him 91 px tall (45 units). Each walk sheet's factor brings its acorn cap, measured across the outline, to the model sheet's cap from the same side (front 123 px, back 132, side 92): front 12.18% (cap 106), back 9.00% (cap 155), side 16.84% (cap 58). No frame is resized, re-registered, or warped on its own.
256x256 frames, feet on row 247 (8 px bottom margin), anchor {x: 0.5, y: 247/256}; pack-atlas.ts, six columns.

measured.sitting: 91 px tall (45 units), his idle down; Maddie stands about 50 units, the Pond Pup 50
measured.hopping: toward us 121-127 px (his tail over his head), away 97-106 px, to the side 85-122 px
measured.areaRatios: idle/walk down 0.84, up 0.99, left 0.92; walk spread down 1.11, up 1.12, left 1.09

validatorOutput: PASS sprite validator: all frames, animations, edges, components, spill, and baseline checks passed
